intent: Review the docs-only cooling comparison against plan 2026-09-14-1215-feat-bridge-cooling-assembly-plan.md, preserving conditional reasoning and checking that no fit, procurement, qualified-trip, or hardware-qualification claim is overstated.

findings.title: Comparison table exceeds the plan's three-concept cap
findings.why_it_matters: R1/U2 require one baseline plus two materially distinct concepts, but the main table contains four rows because the superseded shared fan pair remains in the active comparison.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the superseded row to a distinct historical note or appendix and leave exactly three active comparison rows; update the 'All three concepts' prose accordingly.

findings.title: Compact option is called a measured experiment without measurement evidence
findings.why_it_matters: R7 separates calculated screening from physical fit and hardware qualification; the surrounding records say qualification is not run and the calculations are not measurements.
findings.suggested_fix: Change 'measured lower-bound experiment' to 'future lower-bound experiment' or 'screening experiment', unless a measurement receipt is added.

requirements_completeness.result: R1/U2 need a manual correction because four rows are presented in the main comparison. R2-R7 are substantively addressed with exact source records, hashes, dated snapshots, arithmetic, airflow/system-point caveats, machine-readable envelope, provisional drawing and explicit fit/qualification status. R7 remains intentionally conditional pending physical evidence.

learnings.title: Three-target verification ladder
learnings.note: The docs distinguish sourced calculations from physical fit and hardware qualification; the review preserves those separate evidence rungs.

residual_risks: Enclosure fit/service clearance remains indeterminate without enclosure CAD.
Installed fan/system operating point and distributed heat partition require model or measurement.
Thermal transient, sensor-error and fault qualification remain not run.
Dated distributor snapshots are not procurement commitments and were not independently revalidated in this review.
testing_gaps: No automated gate enforces active concept-row count or measured-versus-screening wording.

coverage.simplify_review: All three ce-simplify-code rubrics were applied inline; no worthwhile behavior-preserving simplification was identified.
coverage.cross_model: Skipped. Parent reported an earlier external cross-model review rejected by autoapproval, and the task prohibited retrying that route. Findings were checked with the local inline fallback.
coverage.standards: Root AGENTS.md and zapote/AGENTS.md were read; no changed-document standards violation was found beyond the explicit R1/U2 row-count issue.

validation.machine_readable_json: All envelope, handoff and proposal JSON records parsed successfully.
validation.link_integrity: Markdown and JSON source links resolved with no errors.
validation.source_hashes: Retained Sanyo, Wakefield, Yangjie, Sunon and Henkel PDF hashes matched sources/README.md.
validation.arithmetic: 27.01 W, 56.92 W/K, 1.84 K and 0.078 °C/W checks matched the documented values.
validation.datasheet_check: Sanyo catalog page 183 was text-inspected; 120 CFM and 100 Pa were treated as endpoints and the low-pressure curve point as conditional.
validation.claim_scan: Fit, qualification, procurement, 70 °C trip, and RθJC aggregate language was checked; no unsafe unconditional claim found.

coverage.review_mode: mode:agent equivalent, report-only; no source docs, code or git history mutation
